properties.name: FIELD REPORT (flo2, 2026-09-18): a settled decision has no change_type; MEASURED on this design, 117 record-axis events carry code-shaped types (12 scope_change, 11 resync, 9 defect_fix, 9 documentation, 5 new_feature, 3 refactor) — the axis decision made `subject` optional and left `change_type` required
properties.source: flo2 reflow2_feedback.md, session 2026-09-18 (Anthony's own project; the agent triaging was this session, root-cause skill run at Anthony's prompt)
properties.statement: F2: 'an open Decision moving to accepted is the most common design event in this project and none of the values names it'; the reporter used new_feature. SEARCHED: dec:change-type-splits-into-two-axes (2026-08-15) chose a second axis over more values. MEASURED: schema/temporal.yaml declares change_type `required: true`; ChangeEvent.subject is optional; 117 ChangeEvents on reflow2's own design carry subject=record, 49 of them with a system-shaped change_type (68 are baseline_established). Also noted: a settlement is already recorded by the status move, the approver edge and the preserved snapshot, so no ChangeEvent is OWED for it — the gap bites only when one is written.
